deviations.php: Objects of classes other than stdClass (real classes, __PHP_Incomplete_Class, the allowed_classes option), C: data of classes with an unserializer, and enum cases (E:) of defined enums.
deviations.reason: Zval models scalars, arrays and stdClass only (the values the libraries serialize). unserialize() returns Error::Unsupported for valid class names other than stdClass, and treats E: like PHP does when the enum class does not exist (no PHP classes exist on the Rust side).

deviations.php: R:/r: back-references create PHP references and shared objects; a back-reference to a container still being read creates a recursive structure.
deviations.reason: Zval has no references or object identity: back-references resolve to a copy of the value at that slot when read (exactly what PHP observes for data serialize() writes), and recursive structures fail with Error::Unsupported. serialize(unserialize($s)) therefore writes copies where PHP writes R:/r: again; the serialize.roundtrip profile leaves back-references out.

deviations.php: Warnings quote enum names byte for byte.
deviations.reason: Unserialized::warnings are Strings: a non-UTF-8 enum name is quoted lossily.
